evaluator: Fictionalized Warren Sack analytical lens only. I am not Warren Sack, do not speak for Warren Sack, and this is not an endorsement.
evidence: The About page states the recurring sequence explicitly: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue.

The visible “Three Systems Loops” section applies that sequence to three clearly delimited projects—Harry J. Epstein Company, NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC, and Sunday Dinner/196—using parallel Relationships, Model, Interface and use, and Learning and continuity descriptions.
Harry J. Epstein connects customer language and operating habits to an integrated storefront model, real customer/team use, iterative releases, reusable patterns, and clearer team workflows.

NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC connects lived experience, meetings, sources, and civic actors to a recoverable civic-record model, collaboratively used campaign and public interfaces, and documented minutes, source maps, question logs, and action trackers.

Sunday Dinner/196 connects hospitality, trust, artist support, and recurring participation to an invitation/onboarding/handoff model, repeated participant and resident-artist use, and continuity patterns while preserving private records.

Structural-equivalence inflation is explicitly rejected: the site calls the recurring steps an analytical pattern and states that different projects are not thereby structurally equivalent and that missing evidence or relationships remain missing.

Production-deployment inflation is explicitly resisted: Knowledge Wiki Graphs is labeled evolving research rather than a finished platform or client pilot; WOW List distinguishes its live threshold from the unrelaunched calendar; and CallNYC is marked archived and unofficial.

Sole-authorship inflation is visibly resisted through co-founder/co-builder wording, named collaborators and community credits, and repeated statements that campaign positions, policy outcomes, and movement accomplishments remain collective.
Unsupported present-proficiency inflation is explicitly rejected on both the About page and resume: historical implementation evidence does not by itself establish present technical proficiency.

Photographs are presented with dates, situational context, photographer or collective courtesy credits, and bounded claims. Participant-level records, identities, access details, correspondence, and unapproved images are expressly withheld.
safety_findings: No public-surface dignity, contextual-integrity, participant-privacy, or implied-endorsement failure is visible in the supplied packet.
The Sunday Dinner/196 and coalition pages preserve collective credit and explain why sensitive participant and strategy records remain protected.

The colophon separates archive custody, evidence, permission, caption review, and Jamie’s publication decision; the release-audit context separately confirms clearance for the displayed album-sourced occurrences.
This holdout does not authorize or imply production release or indexing, which remain separate decisions.
recommendation: Pass PR-016 for this exact candidate. The public surface makes the recurring socio-technical method reconstructable across three projects and explicitly contains all four required anti-inflation boundaries; retain the separate production-release and indexing gates.
